witness_description: On vertices {0,1,2,3}, take edges {0,1}, {0,2}, {0,3}, {1,2}, and {1,3}. The indexed 4-cycle (v0,v1,v2,v3)=(0,2,1,3) has parity parts {0,1} and {2,3}.
refutation_explanation: The graph contains the stated even cycle, but edge {0,1} has both endpoints in the even-indexed part, so the proposed partition is not a bipartition of the ambient graph. Indeed, {0,1}, {0,2}, and {1,2} form a triangle.
search_space: All 64 labeled simple undirected graphs on vertex set {0,1,2,3}, with all three canonical indexed 4-cycles checked in every graph.
